PhysicalPropertyTableImport.SourceNotes: Section VIII Divisions 1/2, specified Class 2 solution-annealed duplex products; source directs TM-1 Group B, not an inferred steel family.

Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TM-1 curve tm-1-05. II-D source notes: Groups A-J use the compositions in source Notes 1-7 and 9-11. Source Notes 8 and 9 repeat Group H membership; the curve explicitly references Note 9. Note 5 includes variations of 9Cr-Mo, but only the literal composition is an automatic key. Note 13 names 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo for S15500; this is retained as printed, without correcting it to a database alias. Note 14 limits S45000 data to material aged at 480 degC; manual applicability review is required.

Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TCD curve tcd-k-11. II-D source notes: Material Groups A-L use source Notes 1-12 (PDF pages 1236-1237). Group A matches the exact Nominal Composition label Carbon steel. Source Notes 9-11 restrict four compositions to 425 degC; maxTemperature on each identity enforces this limit in the reader. Note 9 prints 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo; retained as printed, not corrected to a different database composition. Note 10 explicitly permits separate S and Se compositions. Notes 10-12 also permit H/L/N/LN grades of austenitic stainless steels. Titanium grade/UNS identities are cross-referenced only from the explicit ASME TM-5 grade/UNS pairs, PDF page 1244. No numerical nominal composition is inferred from qualitative alloy labels or UNS.
